name: KUTUHAN
source:
Mom has sent you back home for a week, worried about the state of the home after some recent events. When you go back, everything's seems the same as its ever been. Your cousin is cheerful as ever; your aunt works too hard; and uncle cruises though life carefree.

But there seems to be something off with your grandmother...

A game set in the Philippines, rooted in Filipino culture, about popping lice while bonding with your grandmother in the quiet-ish countryside - away from the hustle and bustle of the urban city. 

Will you get your grandmother to open up? Can you get her to speak her mind? Or will you both speak of life as it always has been?

[From [url=https://rice373.itch.io/kutuhan]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
妈妈因最近发生的一些事情而担心家里的状况，让你回家一周了。当你回去时，一切似乎都和以前一样。你的表弟一如既往地开朗；你阿姨工作太辛苦了；和叔叔游轮虽然生活无忧无虑。

不过你奶奶好像有点不对劲……

这款游戏以菲律宾为背景，植根于菲律宾文化，讲述的是在远离城市喧嚣的安静乡村与祖母建立亲密关系的同时消灭虱子。

你愿意让你的祖母敞开心扉吗？你能让她说出自己的想法吗？还是你们都会像往常一样谈论生活？

[来自[url=https://rice373.itch.io/kutuhan]itch.io[/url]]
